list.filtersSubtitle: Bank payment vouchers for documents that are fully approved and whose paperwork has been received.
list.dateRangeInvalid: Date To cannot be earlier than Date From.
list.loadFailed: Failed to load the BDV list.
list.notInAccurate: Its latest content has not reached Accurate. Open its edit page and press Save to send it again.

print.withSources: Include the FPU/Claim documents being disbursed
print.attachmentNotice: Image attachments are placed one per page. PDF attachments cannot be embedded, but their names are still listed on the last page.
print.attachmentOnSources: Attachments follow each source document rather than the voucher. PDF attachments cannot be embedded, but their names are still listed.

print.windowClosed: The print tab was closed before the file was ready.
print.urlFailed: Failed to create the print link.
print.failed: Failed to generate the BDV printout.

submit.confirmText: {number} will go to its approvers, and from then on it cannot be changed until someone sends it back.
submit.failed: The Bank Disbursement Voucher could not be submitted.

delete.confirmText: {number} will be deleted, and its document will be deleted from Accurate Online as well. This cannot be undone.
delete.loading: Deleting the voucher and its document in Accurate...
delete.failed: The Bank Disbursement Voucher could not be deleted.

create.title: Create Bank Disbursement Voucher
create.subtitle: Choose the document to be disbursed. One BDV raises one document.

step1.title: Department, Branch & Document Type
step1.subtitle: Choose all three first. The document list is then narrowed to this selection.
step1.label: Document Type
step1.filterHint: Only documents from this department and branch are offered. Every document on one BDV must match all three.
step1.typeLocked: Locked because documents are already chosen. Remove them to change the type.

step2.title: Document Number
step2.subtitle: Only documents that are fully approved and whose paperwork has been received appear here.
step2.label: Document Number
step2.hint: Type part of the number or subject to search.
step2.hintMulti: Choose them one at a time. One BDV may disburse several documents.
step2.branchLocked: Every document must come from branch {branch}.
step2.mixedType: One BDV may only disburse a single document type. Remove the chosen documents to switch type.
step2.empty: No document of this type can be raised right now.
step2.loadFailed: Failed to load the document list.
step2.limited: Showing the {count} most recent documents. Type to find others.

step3.mixedBranch: That document is not from branch {branch}. Every document on one BDV must come from the same branch.
step3.title: Document Details
step3.subtitle: Check this before continuing. The amount shown will be copied onto the BDV.
step3.loadFailed: Failed to load the document details.

voucher.title: Voucher Data
voucher.subtitle: Fields belonging to this voucher. Branch follows the selected document.
voucher.cashBankLoadFailed: Failed to load the cash and bank list from Accurate.
voucher.cashBankEmpty: No cash or bank account matches.
voucher.branchFromDocument: Follows the branch of the selected document.
voucher.invalid: Some required fields are still empty. Check the ones marked with an asterisk.
voucher.confirmText: This voucher is posted to Accurate Online as soon as it is saved, even while it is still a draft. Make sure the cash/bank account, the payee and every line account are right.
voucher.saving: Saving the voucher and sending it to Accurate...
voucher.saveFailed: The Bank Disbursement Voucher could not be saved.
voucher.accurateFailed: The BDV was saved, but it has not reached Accurate. Press Save again to retry.

items.title: Line Items
items.subtitle: Taken as-is from the source document and not editable here.
items.subtitleMulti: Grouped per document. An Accurate account is chosen for every line.
items.empty: This document has no line items.
items.mismatch: The items total {items} differs from the document amount {document}. The document amount can be revised when the paperwork is received by Finance, so this gap is not necessarily wrong.
items.accountLoadFailed: Failed to load the account list from Accurate.
items.accountEmpty: The Accurate account list is not connected yet.

detail.title: Bank Disbursement Voucher Detail
detail.subtitle: Read-only. Nothing can be changed from this page.
detail.accurateStale: Latest changes have not reached Accurate
detail.itemsSubtitle: Amounts come from the source document, accounts from this voucher.
detail.approvalEmpty: No approval history yet. This voucher has not been submitted.
detail.approvalResetByRevision: The approval chain was rebuilt when this voucher was returned for revision. Signatures from the previous round are kept in the Revision History below, and a new chain is created once the voucher is submitted again.

approve.dialogSubtitle: Make sure the cash/bank account, the payee and every line account are right before approving.
approve.notesPlaceholder: Add an approval note if needed
approve.failed: The Bank Disbursement Voucher could not be approved.

reject.dialogSubtitle: Rejecting stops the entire approval process for this voucher.
reject.notesRequired: A reason for the rejection is required.
reject.failed: The Bank Disbursement Voucher could not be rejected.

edit.title: Edit Bank Disbursement Voucher
edit.subtitle: Change the voucher data and the list of documents it disburses.
edit.loadFailed: Failed to load the Bank Disbursement Voucher.
edit.notFound: That Bank Disbursement Voucher was not found.
edit.missingId: No voucher was given to edit.

locked.title: This voucher cannot be edited
locked.text: Only draft BDVs can be edited. This one is {status}.
locked.textScope: This voucher is still a draft, but it falls outside the scope of your edit permission. Ask an administrator if you do need to change it.

step1.title: Source Document
step1.subtitle: The documents this voucher disburses. They can be added or removed while it is still a draft.
step1.unavailable: The source document detail cannot be shown right now.
step1.emptied: No document selected yet. A voucher must disburse at least one document.

step2.title: Voucher Data
step2.subtitle: The voucher's own fields, not a copy of the document.

step3.title: Line Items
step3.subtitle: Taken from the source document. The Accurate account for each line is chosen here.
step3.unavailable: The source document detail cannot be shown right now.

edit.confirmText: These changes overwrite the document that already exists in Accurate Online; they do not create a new one. Make sure the cash/bank account, the payee and every line account are right.
edit.saving: Saving the changes and updating them in Accurate...
